rules.description: Draft Clone (Part::FeaturePython) returns its result wrapped in a Compound from FreeCAD 1.1 onward, where 0.20/0.21/1.0 returned a bare Solid. Verified across versions: total_volume_mm3 and total_area_mm2 are identical (10520.727 / 3578.673) in every release from 0.20 to 1.1.3, so only the container type changed, not the geometry. Scoped to this Clone and to shape_type so any real geometry change on it still fails.
